    </dt>
    <dd>NAT gateway ID.</dd><dt class="property-required"
            title="Required">
        <span id="region_yaml">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#region_yaml" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">region</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">String</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Region, e.g. ap-guangzhou.</dd><dt class="property-required"
            title="Required">
        <span id="routingmode_yaml">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#routingmode_yaml" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">routing<wbr>Mode</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">Number</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Traffic steering routing method. 0: multi-route table mode, 1: policy routing mode.</dd><dt class="property-required"
            title="Required">
        <span id="status_yaml">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#status_yaml" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">status</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">String</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Region cluster status. Valid values: <code>NotDeployed</code> (cluster not deployed), <code>Deployed</code> (cluster deployed but traffic steering network not created), <code>DeployedCustomOnly</code> (cluster deployed but internal segment covered, need custom traffic steering segment), <code>Auto</code> (traffic steering network created with auto-assigned CIDR), <code>Custom</code> (traffic steering network created with custom CIDR).</dd></dl>
